caption: The drawing features two tall, rounded ceramic vases positioned side by side, each with a narrow neck and a short, slightly flared rim. Both vases have a mottled surface with shades of grey, beige, and brown, suggesting a natural, earthy texture. The vase on the left displays a fine line drawing of a stylized bird with elongated body and tail feathers, and simple lines denoting legs and claws. The same bird drawing is shown again in a small, separate rectangle at the top left corner of the composition, set against a light brown background. The vase on the right is shown without decoration on its visible side. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, another small rectangle is labeled "REVERSE SIDE," depicting a fine line drawing of a curving stem with three leaves, also against a brown background. The name “Yolande DeLasser” appears in the lower left corner of the image. The entire drawing is on an off-white background, and the objects are rendered in a realistic style with attention to shading and detail.
title: Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
